title: Care Centre Guidance: Timing of a Transfer After the Home Sale, Harbison Parts-and-Labor Protection
content:
**The rule.** On a home-sale transfer of a Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection, Harbison 12-Year Total Protection or Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, a transfer-timing share applies by multiplication to the open benefit carried to the buyer. It is set by the calendar days from the closing date on the transfer request to the date of handling:

| Calendar days from the closing date to the date of handling | Transfer-timing share |
|---|---|
| more than 30 days | 0.93 |
| 15 to 30 days | 0.97 |
| 14 days or fewer | 1 |

**Both sides of each threshold.** 14 days: 1. 15 days: 0.97. 30 days: 0.97. 31 days: 0.93.

**Points of judgement (hypothetical; closing date 1 June 2026).**

- Handled 12 June 2026, 11 days after closing: share 1.
- Handled 1 July 2026, 30 days after closing: share 0.97.
- Handled 2 July 2026, 31 days after closing: share 0.93.
